rows.acceptance: §7.4.14; induced: a failing candidate never reaches the owner; a passing candidate cannot change live trading without a signed promotion; a protected-path candidate is held; the weekly run is scheduled and replays identically from the ledger
rows.text: Continuous governed strategy development: weekly loss clustering and drift review, automatic candidate generation, automatic backtest and validation, only passing candidates sent to the owner, owner-signed one-step promotion, automatic demotion

rows.acceptance: §7.4.15 #1; induced: a tampered new row, a re-chained old row and a deleted row are caught at once; an in-place old-row edit is caught by the next full verification
rows.text: Per-decision ledger verification costs the rows added since a verified anchor, not the whole ledger; full verification at least hourly and after any failure

rows.acceptance: §7.4.15 #2; JPY and metals orders fill under normal slippage; slippage beyond the bound is still refused
rows.text: Slippage bounds are relative to price and converted per instrument (price units for the router, points for MT5)

rows.acceptance: §7.4.15 #3; randomised both-direction test; induced widening fails
rows.text: Tick quantisation never widens the approved stop distance

rows.acceptance: §7.4.15 #4; induced: STOP→LIMIT refused, unsupported type refused, paper limit not filled away from the market; live STOP only after per-venue demo qualification
rows.text: The strategy's entry type is executed as requested or refused, never coerced; resting orders reserve risk, fill only when price reaches them, expire, and on fill seal the thesis and record TCA; a venue refusal ends only that candidate

rows.acceptance: §7.4.15 lockout design; induced: no expiry, legacy top floor, no rebuild, manual counted in the account scope, no probation and unconditional baseline restore each fail a test
rows.text: Recoverable lockouts: per-strategy and account cooldown, probation, weekly escalation to an owner-signed reset; relative drawdown top tier; owner-signed drawdown resume; state rebuilt from the ledger on restart; manual trades in their own scope
